execution_flows.name: Declarative Python Canvas Lifecycle (setup -> draw -> save)
execution_flows.trigger: Direct Python script execution importing drawlib.canvas, drawlib.styles, and domain components
steps: User script calls setup(width, height, dpi, style) via src/drawlib/canvas.py forwarding to Canvas.setup() in src/drawlib/_core/l4_canvas/_canvas.py.
Domain components (Charts, Diagrams, SmartArts, Graph solvers, Icons) validate inputs via @validate_call and emit primitives onto the active Matplotlib/Pillow Canvas.

If an uncached font or icon pack is requested, ReleaseAssetPackage in src/drawlib/_core/l3_external/_package.py lazily downloads and verifies its SHA-256 archive into ~/.cache/drawlib (or DRAWLIB_CACHE_DIR).
Canvas.save() rasterizes or exports PNG/WEBP/SVG/PDF output (unless DrawlibSettings.get_suppress_save() is active during nested get_dimage_from_code() rendering).

execution_flows.name: Illustrated Documentation Build Pipeline (Markdown -> HTML / A4 PDF / DOCX)
execution_flows.trigger: CLI 'drawlib build' on a doc/site/catalog project manifest (drawlib.toml) or Markdown directory
steps: CLI build command (src/drawlib/_cli/commands/build.py) loads drawlib.toml via load_project_manifest() in src/drawlib/_builder/_common/manifest.py and dispatches to build_document().

Markdown processor (src/drawlib/_builder/doc_builder/processor/processor.py) extracts ```drawlib``` fences, computes content + styles.py + utils.py + local-asset SHA-256 keys via BuildImageCache (src/drawlib/_builder/_common/cache.py), and executes uncached blocks.

Format compilers emit static multi-locale HTML sites (compiler/html.py), Playwright headless Chromium A4 PDFs (compiler/pdf.py + _common/browser.py), or native OpenXML Word documents (compiler/docx.py + exporter_docx.py).

execution_flows.name: 16:9 Slide Deck & Interactive Grid Preview Pipeline
execution_flows.trigger: CLI 'drawlib build' on a slide project or 'drawlib show -g' for multimodal AI visual inspection
steps: Slide compiler (src/drawlib/_slide/compiler.py) parses slide Markdown Directives (::: block / ::: note), executes embedded diagrams, and compiles 16:9 HTML decks, PDFs, or native .pptx presentations (src/drawlib/_slide/_pptx_writer.py).
Interactive/headless preview command (src/drawlib/_cli/commands/show.py) renders a single script or embedded Markdown block with optional 10/5-unit coordinate grid (-g) for rapid self-correction.

state_and_storage: Active Canvas singleton instance in src/drawlib/_core/l4_canvas/_base.py holding current Matplotlib Figure/Axes per drawing lifecycle (reset cleanly on setup() / clear()).
DrawlibSettings runtime configuration singleton in src/drawlib/_core/l1_core/_settings.py controlling logging verbosity, validation toggles, and nested save suppression.
Project-local SQLite incremental image cache (.drawlib/cache.db) managed by BuildImageCache and CliImageCache in src/drawlib/_builder/_common/cache.py with size/entry eviction.
User-level external binary cache directory (~/.cache/drawlib or DRAWLIB_CACHE_DIR) storing extracted font/icon release archives and Playwright Chromium lockfiles.
execution_flow_map.error_and_concurrency_model: Synchronous single-process execution per CLI invocation with Pydantic @validate_call boundary validation raising descriptive ValidationError/ValueError messages mapped to clean CLI exit codes via call_command(). Cross-process safety for on-demand Playwright Chromium installation is coordinated via file locks (fcntl in src/drawlib/_builder/_common/browser.py), while SQLite (.drawlib/cache.db) uses per-operation connections with WAL/transactional commits; parallel builds targeting the same project should serialize build.sh execution to avoid SQLite write contention.

audit_dimensions.title: Evaluate Supply-Chain CVEs, Container Misconfigs, Secrets, Dangerous Sinks & API Boundaries
audit_dimensions.summary: Trivy SCA/IaC/secret scanning and AST CWE analysis show strong first-party code security (0 SQLi, 0 command injection, 0 hardcoded source secrets, explicit CI 'permissions: contents: read', default-deny .dockerignore, and SHA-256 release-asset verification), alongside two actionable supply-chain remediations: (1) all 41 application CVEs in uv.lock (5 CRITICAL, 23 HIGH, 13 MEDIUM; os_vuln_counts=0) originate from a single package, pillow@12.3.0, and are resolved by upgrading to pillow>=13.0.0; and (2) tools/docker/Dockerfile.prod, Dockerfile.test_local, and Dockerfile.test_pypi run as root (DS-0002 HIGH), while SECURITY.md and .github/dependabot.yml remain absent. Five CWE-94 exec() calls power Drawlib's intentional 'Illustration as Code' engine and should be documented with an explicit trust-boundary warning in SECURITY.md.

audit_dimensions.title: Evaluate Buildability, Offline Test Results, Measured Coverage & Startup Health
audit_dimensions.summary: Containerized clean-room runtime verification succeeded on isolated image build (RV-01: passed in 3.76s), CLI/library startup smoke check (RV-04: passed in 2.42s), and measured execution coverage (RV-03: 86.3% line coverage across 37,221/43,108 statements and 75.5% branch coverage). Hermetic offline unit testing under --network=none (RV-02) achieved a 98.7% pass rate (1,393 passed, 19 failed, 8 skipped in 527.08s), exposing two authentic live-network assumptions masked by online CI: (1) 12 test_nonexistent_*_icon_error tests fail offline because download_if_not_exist() in src/drawlib/_core/l3_external/_download.py unconditionally attempts HTTPS archive downloads for any path under a known icon family without checking pkg.files or pkg.is_downloaded() first (plus 1 uncached CJK monospace font test), and (2) 6 PPTX export tests attempt runtime Chromium downloads from cdn.playwright.dev when browser binaries are absent from the container harness.

audit_dimensions.title: Evaluate Supply-Chain, CI Permissions, Container & Secret Hygiene
audit_dimensions.summary: Supply-chain and secret hygiene combine strong cryptographic asset verification (SHA-256 checks + 60s timeout on GitHub Release downloads in _package.py), least-privilege CI tokens (permissions: contents: read across all 4 workflows), zero hardcoded secrets, and Git-ignored credential files. Key hardening items remain: tools/docker/Dockerfile.prod runs as root without a non-root USER directive, GitHub Actions steps use mutable major tags (@v4/@v5) instead of commit SHAs, and SECURITY.md / Dependabot automation are not yet configured.

audit_dimensions.title: Evaluate Repository Structure, Supply Chain & Dependencies
audit_dimensions.summary: Repository structure, dependency hygiene, documentation, and CI token permissions are well-engineered: PEP 621 metadata in pyproject.toml declares all 13 runtime dependencies with SemVer lower bounds, isolates dev tools in [dependency-groups].dev, ships a PEP 561 py.typed marker, enforces contents: read permissions across all 4 GitHub Actions workflows, and maintains a rich Diataxis documentation suite (README.md + docs/ + docs/api/ + docs/architecture/). Minor governance gaps remain around missing SECURITY.md, missing Dependabot/Renovate automation, major-tag GitHub Action pins, and an intentionally gitignored uv.lock.

audit_dimensions.title: Evaluate Public API Boundaries, Import Purity, SemVer & Diátaxis Docs
audit_dimensions.summary: Public library hygiene in drawlib is exceptionally well-designed around PEP 562 lazy submodule loading in src/drawlib/__init__.py (zero import-time heavy/network side effects), curated __all__ exports across all 20 public facade modules, PEP 561 py.typed support, flexible >= SemVer bounds across all 13 runtime dependencies, and mechanical 100% API reference completeness (docs/api/). Minor library-vs-CLI coupling opportunities exist where _core/l1_core/_settings.py and _builder/.../viewer.py invoke sys.exit(1) directly instead of raising exceptions to the CLI boundary, alongside 30 print() calls and 9 direct os.environ reads in _builder/.

audit_dimensions.title: Interpret Python AST Facts & Evaluate Quality/Typing/Imports/Security
audit_dimensions.summary: Python AST audit across 424 source files (85,323 LOC, 300 classes, 1,958 functions) confirms exceptionally strong static hygiene: 100.0% function type-annotation coverage, 0 unscoped # type: ignore comments, 99.3% docstring coverage, 99.3% import hygiene, 0 undeclared dependencies, 0 hardcoded secrets, 0 missing I/O timeouts, and 0 mutable global state usages. Core layered boundaries (l1_core -> l2_types -> l3_* -> l4_canvas -> domain packages -> public facades) are acyclic, with only 2 small intra-package sibling cycles (_edge <-> _junction in architecture and flow diagrams), localized high-cognitive-complexity functions in DOCX/HTML compilers, and 5 intentional Python exec() sites that power Drawlib's 'Illustration as Code' execution engine.

audit_dimensions.title: Evaluate Test Suite Completeness & Structure
audit_dimensions.summary: Drawlib's test suite (150 test files, 1,293 test functions across tests/drawlib/) demonstrates exemplary architectural mirror coverage (100.0% module coverage) and visual regression rigor: tests/conftest.py intercepts every test execution via pytest_runtest_call to compare rendered PNGs pixel-by-pixel against golden *_answers/*.png baselines (zero assertion-free tests), while resetting Canvas state via an autouse preprocess fixture. One clean-room test harness drift was identified: tests/drawlib/doc_builder/test_api_docs_completeness.py asserts against docs_src/api/, which is currently excluded from root .dockerignore and tools/docker/Dockerfile.test_local.

audit_dimensions.title: Evaluate CLI Ergonomics, Streams, Exit Codes & Automation UX
audit_dimensions.summary: The drawlib Typer + Rich CLI (src/drawlib/_cli/_drawlib.py) exemplifies modern developer & AI-agent ergonomics: consistent -h/--help with rich examples (HELP_EPILOG, no_args_is_help=True), eager -v/--version, mutually validated --quiet/--verbose/--debug/--developer verbosity flags, headless CI modes (serve --check --no-browser, show -o -g, cache download --all), and 211 dedicated CLI tests. Minor polish opportunities include enabling optional shell completion or routing progress print() diagnostics to stderr.

consolidated_findings.combined_evidence: Trivy SCA (SEC-01) reported 41 application CVEs in pillow@12.3.0 (5 CRITICAL CVSS 9.8: CVE-2026-112393, CVE-2026-112398, CVE-2026-112403, CVE-2026-112900, CVE-2026-96639; 23 HIGH including CVE-2026-96778 and GHSA-78g4-xqwv-q3g8; 13 MEDIUM), all fixed in pillow 13.0.0.
consolidated_findings.merged_recommendation: Run 'uv lock --upgrade-package pillow' to resolve pillow>=13.0.0 (updating pyproject.toml lower bound to 'pillow>=13.0.0' once Python 3.11-3.13 wheel compatibility and pixel-exact test baselines are verified).

consolidated_findings.primary_description: Invalid icon lookups trigger live HTTPS archive downloads from GitHub Releases instead of failing fast via manifest membership checks, breaking 12 negative icon tests (and uncached font tests like test_sourcecode_japanese) in air-gapped --network=none environments.
consolidated_findings.combined_evidence: 12 test_nonexistent_*_icon_error tests failed under --network=none with 'RuntimeError: Failed to download asset package ... <urlopen error [Errno -3] Temporary failure in name resolution>' because find_package_for_icon_path() matches directory prefixes without checking pkg.files and download_if_not_exist() unconditionally calls pkg.download_and_extract().
consolidated_findings.merged_recommendation: Check whether the requested relative filename exists in pkg.files before attempting network I/O (raising FileNotFoundError immediately for nonexistent asset names), check pkg.is_downloaded() before re-downloading, and pre-seed external assets in .pni/dockerfiles/Dockerfile.

consolidated_findings.primary_description: Production and test container images execute drawlib (including embedded Python diagram exec() blocks and headless Chromium) as UID 0 (root).
consolidated_findings.combined_evidence: Trivy DS-0002 (HIGH) on tools/docker/Dockerfile.prod, tools/docker/Dockerfile.test_local, and tools/docker/Dockerfile.test_pypi: 'Specify at least 1 USER command in Dockerfile with non-root user as argument'.
consolidated_findings.merged_recommendation: Create a dedicated unprivileged user (e.g., 'useradd --uid 10001 --create-home drawlib') and switch to 'USER drawlib' before ENTRYPOINT/CMD in tools/docker/Dockerfile.prod and test Dockerfiles.

consolidated_findings.primary_description: Repository lacks SECURITY.md vulnerability disclosure instructions and automated Dependabot/Renovate CVE pull requests (which would have surfaced the pillow 13.0.0 security release automatically), and relies on a local .env token for PyPI publishing.
consolidated_findings.combined_evidence: ProjectFacts: SECURITY.md=False, dependency_automation=False; Trivy SEC-03 also detected a local untracked/gitignored .env file containing a redacted pypi-upload-token (PYPI_TOKEN=***). | ProjectFacts.has_security_policy == False (no SECURITY.md present at repository root).
consolidated_findings.merged_recommendation: Add SECURITY.md (covering disclosure policy and the exec() trust boundary), add .github/dependabot.yml for pip/uv and github-actions ecosystems, and migrate PyPI publishing to GitHub Actions OIDC Trusted Publishing or OS keyring. / Add a root SECURITY.md file documenting supported drawlib versions and instructions for reporting security vulnerabilities via GitHub Private Vulnerability Reporting.

consolidated_findings.primary_description: Playwright-dependent PPTX export tests attempt on-demand Chromium downloads during test execution rather than skipping gracefully when offline without a pre-installed browser or baking 'playwright install --only-shell chromium' into the verification harness.
consolidated_findings.combined_evidence: 6 PPTX export tests (tests/drawlib/cli/test_cli_build.py::test_cli_build_pptx and 5 tests in tests/drawlib/slide/test_pptx.py) failed under --network=none with EAI_AGAIN resolving cdn.playwright.dev when chromium-headless-shell was not pre-installed in .pni/dockerfiles/Dockerfile.
consolidated_findings.merged_recommendation: Pre-install chromium-headless-shell and OS dependencies in .pni/dockerfiles/Dockerfile for full offline PPTX/PDF coverage, and guard browser integration tests with a clear skip/fixture check when running offline without local Chromium binaries.

consolidated_findings.primary_description: DOCX AST-to-OpenXML rendering concentrates token dispatch, inline formatting, and table emission in multi-hundred-line functions with high cognitive complexity.
consolidated_findings.combined_evidence: exporter_docx.py (945 LOC) contains top cognitive-complexity routines render_chapter (line 565, cognitive=174, 283 lines), _render_inline (line 301, cognitive=102), and export_chapters_to_docx (line 884, cognitive=46, 202 lines).
consolidated_findings.merged_recommendation: Decompose render_chapter and _render_inline into per-token handler functions (heading, code fence, callout, list, table) dispatched via a token-type table.

consolidated_findings.primary_description: Fence attribute parsing in parse_block_info and multi-chapter HTML merging in build_merged_html accumulate high branch counts.
consolidated_findings.combined_evidence: parse_block_info (length=74 lines, branches=33, cognitive=106) and merger.py:142 build_merged_html (length=260 lines, branches=40, cognitive=87) exceed SIG cognitive complexity <= 15.
consolidated_findings.merged_recommendation: Extract per-attribute validators from parse_block_info and split TOC assembly, asset rewriting, and heading normalization out of build_merged_html.

consolidated_findings.primary_description: Drawlib's 'Illustration as Code' architecture intentionally executes embedded Python blocks, styles.py, and utils.py via builtin exec() with full host interpreter privileges; processing untrusted Markdown or third-party projects without isolation allows arbitrary code execution.
consolidated_findings.combined_evidence: 5 CWE-94 exec() call sites: src/drawlib/_builder/_common/styles_loader.py:78,158, src/drawlib/_builder/doc_builder/processor/processor.py:121,123, and src/drawlib/_core/l4_canvas/_image_code.py:54.
consolidated_findings.merged_recommendation: Document the code-execution trust model prominently in SECURITY.md and README.md, recommending isolated non-root containers (--network=none) whenever rendering untrusted Markdown or diagram sources.

consolidated_findings.primary_description: Production container images built via './dcli docker build' execute drawlib (including Python exec() on Markdown/scripts and headless Chromium) as UID 0 (root).
consolidated_findings.combined_evidence: tools/docker/Dockerfile.prod (lines 1-44) installs drawlib into python:3.12-slim and sets WORKDIR /workspace without creating or switching to a non-root USER.
consolidated_findings.merged_recommendation: Create a dedicated unprivileged user (e.g. groupadd/useradd -u 10001 drawlib), set PLAYWRIGHT_BROWSERS_PATH=/opt/ms-playwright with world-readable permissions, and switch to USER drawlib before WORKDIR /workspace.

consolidated_findings.primary_description: Automated dependency and GitHub Actions version update scanning (Dependabot or Renovate) is not configured.
consolidated_findings.combined_evidence: ProjectFacts.has_dependency_automation == False (no .github/dependabot.yml or renovate.json found).
consolidated_findings.merged_recommendation: Add .github/dependabot.yml covering pip/uv and github-actions ecosystems on a weekly or monthly schedule.

consolidated_findings.primary_description: GitHub Actions workflows reference mutable major version tags (@v4, @v5) rather than immutable 40-character commit SHAs.
consolidated_findings.combined_evidence: uses: actions/checkout@v4 (line 20), astral-sh/setup-uv@v5 (line 23), and actions/setup-python@v5 (line 28) across .github/workflows/*.yml.
consolidated_findings.merged_recommendation: Pin third-party GitHub Actions (especially astral-sh/setup-uv) to full commit SHAs with version comments and keep them updated via Dependabot.

consolidated_findings.primary_description: On-demand Playwright driver installation subprocess has no upper-bound timeout, which could stall headless CLI builds indefinitely on degraded networks.
consolidated_findings.combined_evidence: subprocess.run([str(exec_path), str(cli_path), *_INSTALL_ARGS], ...) at browser.py:210 omits an explicit timeout=... argument.
consolidated_findings.merged_recommendation: Pass an explicit timeout (e.g., timeout=300) to subprocess.run() in install_headless_chromium() and translate subprocess.TimeoutExpired into an actionable RuntimeError.

consolidated_findings.primary_description: Invalid configuration or viewer error paths call sys.exit(1) inside core/builder modules, terminating host Python processes when drawlib is embedded programmatically as a library.
consolidated_findings.combined_evidence: sys.exit(1) called directly in src/drawlib/_core/l1_core/_settings.py (lines 123, 297, 304, 313) and src/drawlib/_builder/doc_builder/processor/viewer.py (lines 189, 193, 245).
consolidated_findings.merged_recommendation: Raise ValueError or a dedicated DrawlibError subclass in _settings.py and viewer.py, and translate those exceptions to exit code 1 solely in _cli/_drawlib.py:call_command.

consolidated_findings.primary_description: Drawlib executes embedded Python code blocks and project styles.py/utils.py via Python's builtin exec() without OS process sandboxing.
consolidated_findings.combined_evidence: 5 CWE-94 exec() call sites: styles_loader.py:78,158, processor.py:121,123, and _image_code.py:54.
consolidated_findings.merged_recommendation: Preserve exec() for local 'Illustration as Code' authoring, and explicitly document in security docs/CLI help that drawlib build/show must only be run on trusted Markdown and Python sources (or inside an isolated --network=none container for untrusted inputs).

consolidated_findings.primary_description: Two sibling modules (_edge.py and _junction.py) in architecture and flow diagrams import each other at runtime for fluent operator chaining.
consolidated_findings.combined_evidence: AstFacts.circular_dependencies = [['drawlib._diagrams.architecture._edge', 'drawlib._diagrams.architecture._junction', 'drawlib._diagrams.architecture._edge'], ['drawlib._diagrams.flow._edge', 'drawlib._diagrams.flow._junction', 'drawlib._diagrams.flow._edge']].
consolidated_findings.merged_recommendation: Move runtime cross-type checks to a shared _types.py protocol/base class and guard concrete sibling imports under if TYPE_CHECKING:.

consolidated_findings.primary_description: Offline Chromium unavailability left PPTX writer/DOM extractor and PDF compiler branches under-exercised relative to core rendering modules, alongside 0% direct coverage on __main__.py and PEP 562 icon package __getattr__ fallbacks.
consolidated_findings.combined_evidence: Lowest covered non-generated modules: src/drawlib/__main__.py (0.0%, lines 12-23), src/drawlib/_slide/_pptx_writer.py (11.1% line / 0.0% branch, lines 81-90), src/drawlib/_icons/__init__.py (33.3%, lines 99-109), src/drawlib/_builder/doc_builder/compiler/pdf.py (52.2% line / 38.9% branch, lines 51, 97-115), and src/drawlib/_slide/_pptx_dom.py (58.6% line / 4.0% branch, lines 989-1011).
consolidated_findings.merged_recommendation: Add direct unit tests for _pptx_writer.py OpenXML shape/table generation using synthetic PptxSlide DOM fixtures (decoupled from Playwright) plus lightweight CLI __main__ and icon __getattr__ error-path tests.

consolidated_findings.primary_description: Clean-room Docker test images built via tools/docker/Dockerfile.test_local (and Dockerfile.test_pypi) omit docs_src/api/, causing test_api_docs_completeness.py to fail or require pytest.skip when docs_src/api/ is absent.
consolidated_findings.combined_evidence: test_api_docs_completeness.py:31 reads REPO_ROOT / 'docs_src' / 'api', whereas root .dockerignore ignores docs_src/ and tools/docker/Dockerfile.test_local:27 runs 'rm -rf ./src ./docs_src'.
consolidated_findings.merged_recommendation: Unignore docs_src/api/ in .dockerignore + COPY docs_src/api/ in Dockerfile.test_local, or call pytest.skip('docs_src/api not present in packaged test environment') when API_DOCS_DIR is absent.

consolidated_findings.primary_description: uv.lock is excluded in .gitignore to keep cross-Python (3.11-3.13) CI resolution flexible, trading deterministic contributor lockfile pinning for library compatibility breadth.
consolidated_findings.combined_evidence: .gitignore excludes uv.lock even though uv.lock is generated locally (lockfiles_found=['uv.lock']).
consolidated_findings.merged_recommendation: Document the intentional library lockfile policy in contributor docs or commit uv.lock while running separate --resolution=lowest-direct / matrix checks in CI.

consolidated_findings.primary_description: Environment variable lookups (e.g. DRAWLIB_*, SOURCE_DATE_EPOCH, PLAYWRIGHT_*) and builder progress print() statements are dispersed across _builder modules rather than centralized through DrawlibSettings / structured logger.
consolidated_findings.combined_evidence: scattered_env_access=9 across browser.py:40,45,48, cache.py:516,518, office.py:40, exporter_pdf.py:31, viewer.py:161, and rules_builder.py:174; unstructured_logging=30 print() calls in _builder/.
consolidated_findings.merged_recommendation: Centralize DRAWLIB_* environment resolution in a typed builder config helper and route non-CLI diagnostic output through drawlib's logger.

consolidated_findings.primary_description: Shell autocompletion is disabled on the public drawlib CLI (add_completion=False) and human-readable build progress writes to stdout rather than stderr.
consolidated_findings.combined_evidence: typer.Typer(..., add_completion=False) in src/drawlib/_cli/_drawlib.py:38 and progress print() statements in src/drawlib/_builder/_common/progress.py:138 writing to stdout.
consolidated_findings.merged_recommendation: Consider enabling optional shell completion or routing human progress messages to stderr if future subcommands emit machine-parseable JSON to stdout.

consolidated_findings.primary_description: Twelve fluent builder methods in SmartArt node classes omit brief one-line docstrings.
consolidated_findings.combined_evidence: missing_docstrings=12 across fluent setter methods on MindMapNode (_mindmap.py:93-156), TreeNode (_tree.py:86), and BulletPoints (_bulletpoints.py:48).
consolidated_findings.merged_recommendation: Add concise Google-style one-line docstrings to fluent builder methods in _mindmap.py, _tree.py, and _bulletpoints.py to reach 100.0% docstring coverage.

summary: Drawlib v0.3.5 achieves an overall score of 90/100 (Grade A) across 424 Python modules (85,323 LOC) and 150 test files. The codebase demonstrates exemplary type safety (100.0% coverage, 0 unscoped type: ignore), documentation & AI-agent ergonomics (99.3% docstrings, 60+ embedded rules), and layered architectural discipline (L1-L4 -> Domains -> Builders/CLI -> Public Facades). Containerized air-gapped runtime verification (--network=none) measured 86.3% line and 75.5% branch coverage while uncovering two high-value engineering improvements invisible to online CI: fast-failing nonexistent asset names via pkg.files before attempting HTTPS downloads in _download.py, and upgrading pillow@12.3.0 -> >=13.0.0 in uv.lock alongside non-root Dockerfile USER hardening to clear all 41 Trivy SCA findings.
